title: Memoirs of a Hamster
author: Devin Scillian
intro: Seymour the hamster has a cosy cage, a bowl full of seeds, and an exercise wheel. He thinks he is the luckiest hamster in the world!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What kind of animal is Seymour?
questions.clue: He is small and lives in a cage with wood shavings.

questions.q: What gets put in Seymour's cage on Night Two?
questions.clue: Seymour loves to run on it all night long.
questions.yes: Seymour gets a shiny new exercise wheel.

questions.q: Who takes care of Seymour and gives him treats?
questions.clue: She is a child who lives in the house.
questions.yes: Little Girl takes care of Seymour.

questions.q: Where does Seymour hide his second yoghurt drop to save for later?
questions.clue: Hamsters have pouches on the sides of their faces.
questions.yes: Seymour tucks the second yoghurt drop in his cheek.

questions.q: Which animal comes to talk to Seymour beside his cage first?
questions.clue: She has claws, purrs, and likes to chase small animals.
questions.yes: Pearl the cat comes to talk to Seymour.

questions.q: What does Pearl say the staircase outside the cage is made of?
questions.clue: It is the same kind of seed Seymour eats in his bowl.
questions.yes: Pearl tells him the staircase is made of sunflower seeds.

questions.q: Where does Pearl say all the yoghurt drops are kept?
questions.clue: It is a bright, sunny room in the house.
questions.yes: Pearl says the sunroom is filled with yoghurt drops.

questions.q: Who is Buck, the other pet who sniffs Seymour's cage?
questions.clue: He barks, howls, and trots around the house.
questions.yes: Buck is a big goofy dog.

questions.q: How does Seymour stop his wheel from spinning so he can climb out?

options.text: He jams a sunflower seed in it

questions.clue: Pearl tells him to wedge a piece of food beside the wheel.
questions.yes: Seymour jams a sunflower seed beside the wheel to climb up.

questions.q: Why did Pearl trick Seymour into leaving his safe cage?

options.text: She wanted to eat him for dinner
She wanted to share her toys

questions.clue: Pearl looked really hungry when Seymour reached the sunroom.
questions.yes: Pearl tricked Seymour because she wanted to eat him.

questions.q: Where does Seymour hide after running away from Pearl?
questions.clue: It is a soft piece of living room furniture people sit on.
questions.yes: Seymour hides under the sofa to stay safe from Pearl.

questions.q: How did Seymour feel while hiding under the sofa?
questions.clue: He thought he was in big trouble and wrote out his will.
questions.yes: Seymour felt scared while hiding from Pearl.

questions.q: What is Hoover, the noisy monster that chases Seymour?
questions.clue: It rolls on the carpet and tries to suck Seymour inside.
questions.yes: Hoover is a noisy vacuum cleaner.

questions.q: Who rescues Seymour from Hoover, Pearl, and Buck?
questions.clue: She shouts his name and gives him a sweet kiss on the nose.
questions.yes: Little Girl rescues Seymour and puts him back in his cage.

questions.q: Why does Seymour decide to stay in his cage at the end?

options.text: His cage is safe and has everything

questions.clue: He has seeds, cosy wood shavings, and room to run in peace.
questions.yes: Seymour stays because his cage is safe and has everything he needs.
